description: Research r9 (dev only): r5 a01_fp32_lr1e-6_skip_cos_mal0 (A 001 + fp32 master weights at lr 1e-6, cosine decay to 1e-7 over the 290-min budget, training reward 0 for malformed or truncated outputs) with Clip-Cov on 0.1% of each micro-batch's tokens (the largest log-prob x advantage covariance) and skipping off (Clip-Cov needs every row).
